name: Torikaekko Shiyo! ~Kareshi Kanojo no Himitsu no Kankei~
original_name: とりかえっ娘しよッ! ～彼氏彼女の秘密の関係～
source:
Iori is a high school student. He has a girlfriend, Miki, but she recently gives him a cold shoulder. One day, Miki says, "Why don't we try swapping sex?" Iori can't understand what she means at first. But he doesn't want to be dumped so he accepts it. And she chooses Yuki and Shoko as swap partners. Iori is surprised to know that because Shoko is the girl Iori had his first sex with. Iori is totally confused....

translation: 伊织是一名高中生。他有一个女朋友美纪，但她最近对他态度冷淡。某天，美纪说："我们试试交换性伴侣怎么样？"伊织一时无法理解她的意思。但他不想被甩，便答应了。她选了雪和翔子作为交换对象。伊织大为震惊，因为翔子正是他第一次发生关系的女孩。伊织完全不知所措了……\n\n[来自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/5520]Himeya Shop[/url]]
